title: Splacube ULTIMATE
body:
# Why I create the mod ?
A long time ago, I created Splacube. But now, I think the mod is ugly, then I re-created the mod with better feathures :
- New texture for paint blocks ![The new paint blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4ff44513d9db3f2d320389546f30b4178cff2f2f.png)
- New Paint Guns !
- Better Splash !![The splash !](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d7b97be862da438eec88418b29e9ce6a631edc8d.png)
- New battle system !
- 2 new colors : red and purple !
# What the mod add finally ?
The mod add 6 team colors : Pink, Blue, Purple, Yellow, Red and Green and the guns for throw the paint !
# How to join a team ?
Just put the "hairs" on your head and put the gun in your hand.

### You can use the mod like you want. Create your own map !

Don't forget to leave a comment if you want more features !
Here's my discord for suggest ideas or report an issue : https://discord.gg/7yXRx6yVVy
